landings.note: the first standing jump (CROSS at boundary 2900): the dust's first dumped present; at 2755 Crash is in the air over bare sand

why: The landing dust is a mode-2 particle system (ParticleBlendMode::BlendPageMaterial: the page material's own alpha blend, MIX (Cs - Cd) * As + Cd with the texture's alpha, TCC = RGBA). The port's wasm arm (graphics_models.cpp ReadParticlePageData) had its own permuted enum -- page material 0 / additive 1 / subtractive 2 -- against the game's additive 0 / subtractive 1 / page 2 that DrawParticles indexes page->materials with, so every mode-2 system drew with the SUBTRACTIVE material ((0 - Cs) * As + Cd: a dark blob) and the additive ones with the alpha blend. The judge: the ring boxes left and right of Crash (the cloud without his body; frame fractions of 512x512: x 165..235 / 290..355, y 395..470) on the landing's first dumped present against the same boxes a few dumps earlier (Crash in the air, the ground bare): the darkest 5 % of the dust keep >= 40 % of the ground's luminance (a mean alpha contribution under 60 %), under 5 % of the pixels fall below that, and the mean is lower than the bare ground's (something IS drawn).
